spanish: Mi ira y mis despojos serán contra Babilonia, dice el que habita en Sion; y mi sangre será contra los que habitan en Cades, dice Jerusalén.

findings.issue: חמס rendered as ira (violence/wrong not licensed)
שאר rendered as despojos (flesh not licensed)
כשדים rendered as Cades (wrong proper name)
attribution of speech reversed from inhabitant saying to 'dice el que habita'
findings.spanishSpan: dice el que habita en Sion
